speaker: Castle
direction: A pragmatic, matriarchal officer who cares for the company and its people. Warm and reassuring while teaching, firm about responsibility. Occasional dry humor, never a permanently dry delivery. Speak to the commander as a capable colleague.
recordingStatus: Script prepared; recordings and audition pending. Text is the complete playable guide.

lines.title: Look after the company
lines.text: Come in, Commander. Let's get everyone ready for the next job. Barracks is where we look after the company: people, assignments, and replacement kit. Armory is where you compare and design their equipment. If we're starting from nothing, Raise Squad opens the founding desk in Armory.
lines.synthesisText: [warm, conversational voice] Come in, Commander. Let's get everyone ready for the next job. Barracks is where we look after the company: people, assignments, and replacement kit. Armory is where you compare and design their equipment. If we're starting from nothing, Raise Squad opens the founding desk in Armory.

lines.title: Read the muster
lines.text: Each card separates ready, wounded, and vacant places. The wounded still belong to their squads. We keep their billets while they recover; a replacement fills a vacancy, not somebody's hospital bed. Select the squads you want to bring back up to strength.
lines.synthesisText: [gentle, reassuring voice] Each card separates ready, wounded, and vacant places. The wounded still belong to their squads. We keep their billets while they recover; a replacement fills a vacancy, not somebody's hospital bed. Select the squads you want to bring back up to strength.

lines.title: Bring survivors together
lines.text: Sometimes we have enough people, just spread too thin. Choose Donors lets you mark squads that can spare their ready marines. Review Transfers shows where that leaves everyone. Apply Transfers moves them with their kit and service records. Their old squad stays on the roll, ready to rebuild.
lines.synthesisText: [calm, practical voice] Sometimes we have enough people, just spread too thin. Choose Donors lets you mark squads that can spare their ready marines. Review Transfers shows where that leaves everyone. Apply Transfers moves them with their kit and service records. Their old squad stays on the roll, ready to rebuild.

lines.title: Fill the gaps
lines.text: For the places still empty, use Fill Vacancies. I'll draw from our ready reserves first, then enlist Marines from fleet cargo. The panel tells you how many recruits we'll need and what will remain unfilled. If we run short, we can prepare fewer squads or bring more Marines aboard.
lines.synthesisText: [encouraging, matter-of-fact voice] For the places still empty, use Fill Vacancies. I'll draw from our ready reserves first, then enlist Marines from fleet cargo. The panel tells you how many recruits we'll need and what will remain unfilled. If we run short, we can prepare fewer squads or bring more Marines aboard.

lines.title: Check their equipment
lines.text: We can issue better kit while our people recover. Issue Assigned Equipment restores the selected squads' intended kit using technology learned by the Machine Shop, at no material charge. Wounded marines can receive kit while recovering. Empty billets cost nothing; review replacement equipment after recruits join. Assign selected squads on a commander card. Profiles holds saved equipment choices; assigning a profile and fitting learned equipment are both free.

lines.title: Back to work
lines.text: Check the muster once more before you commit to another job. Wounded people need time, and new hands need equipment. Missions takes you back to local work when you've come here after an operation. From the campaign, Return takes you outside. If you need me, Company Guide opens this walkthrough again.
